chunks: And you would have seen the sun, when it rose, inclining away from their cave to the right, and when it set, turning away from them to the left, and they were within an open space thereof.
That is from the signs of Allah. And whoever Allah guides - there is for him no guide; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for him a protecting guide.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the sun's movement in relation to the Sleepers of the Cave?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine providence (tawfiq) that shielded the Sleepers, with the sun's deviation serving as a physical manifestation of Allah's power over creation. The concluding phrase 'man yahdi Allahu huwa al-muhtadi' is often interpreted to emphasize that true guidance is a direct gift from Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine grace in the believer's journey.
